silhouette.reason: Long legs, tucked waist, neck carrying the head forward, upright ears, bushy tail to the hocks and a fur fringe along the back and chest: reads as a wild canid from every view. The narrow, long muzzle, big ears and slim chest read closer to a coyote than a grey wolf.
fixes: broaden the muzzle and skull and deepen the chest so the head and front read as a grey wolf, not a coyote

proportions.reason: 1.3 x 0.3 x 0.9 m fits the sourced head+body and withers; by eye the head is small and the snout long and thin for a wolf, the ears large, and the hind cannons long in the side view.
fixes: skull width ~0.55 of skull length with a shorter, deeper muzzle
shorten the hind cannon toward the dossier skeleton

materials.reason: Agouti saddle, buff flanks, cream chest and belly, dark tail tip and glossy nose read; strand cards along the back and chest break the outline like fur, but the body between reads as smooth painted velvet, and the grey chest goes lilac under the cool key.
fixes: fur shells or more strand cards over the flanks and shoulders, not only the fringe
warm the chest cream so it does not go lilac

detail.reason: Eyes with lids, nose, lip line, knuckled toes with claws and pads, ear interiors, chest ruff; the coat surface has no hair-flow relief at hero distance, and the face has no cheek ruff or brow fur.
fixes: guard-hair relief following the hair flow on the flanks
cheek ruff and brow tufts on the head

wear.reason: No story: clean coat, no matted or wet fur, no mud on the paws or belly, no scars.
fixes: grime({ ground }) mud on paws and lower legs
darker matted streaks on the flank and a nick in one ear

lod.reason: lods.png: LOD2 (2.3k) keeps the pose and outline, but the fur fringe and tail volume go, legs become pale faceted tubes with boxy paws, and the saddle colour washes out to one beige.
fixes: 8-sided leg tubes and rounded paws at LOD2 within budget
paint the agouti saddle as a darker block at LOD2 so the value pattern holds

technical.reason: QA clean (pack): 141.7k / 25.9k / 2.3k tris, inside the 150k / 35k / 4k budget; most LOD0 triangles go to smooth flank areas that do not need them. The pack hero re-render drifted from the committed hero.png bytes (visually identical).
fixes: adaptive cell size: finer on the head and paws, coarser on the flanks
re-run bun run shots wolf so the committed hero matches a fresh render byte for byte
